The debt-equity ratio for the 2024-29 tariff period is calculated in accordance with Regulation 18 of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. Accordingly, the debt-equity ratio [para 82] 82. The Petitioner has submitted Form 9C for the 2019-24 tariff period, incorporating consolidated actual loans for the entire project. In the absence of a separate Form-9C for the individual assets, the Weighted Average Rate of Interest (WAROI) claimed by the Petitioner in the consolidated tariff Form-9C has been considered in tariff calculations. Accordingly, the WAROI considered for FY 2023-24 has also been applied to work out Interest on Loan (IoL) for the 2024-29 tariff period, subject to review at the time of truing-up. The Petitioner is directed to submit a separate Form-9C for individual assets and allocation of loans to these individual assets duly certified by the auditor at the time of truing-up. [para 98] 98. The transmission charges allowed in respect of the Combined Assets for the 2024-29 tariff period are as follows: [para 99] 99. The Petitioner, in the instant Petition, has prayed that the transmission charges determined herein shall be recovered on a monthly basis and that billing, collection and disbursement shall be governed by the provisions of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of Inter-State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2010 (“the 2010 Sharing Regulations”). With effect from 1.11.2020, upon repeal of the 2010 Sharing Regulations, sharing of transmission charges is governed by the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of Inter-State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2020 (“the 2020 Sharing Regulations”).
